description: Numerical falsification of the simple-uniform-multiplicity reading of conj:weinberg-angle-categorical: cot θ_W ≈ q_0^{-4} would give 0.66 at q_0 while CODATA target is 1.823 (rel err 64%).  Records the informative null result that motivates the non-uniform Hoefsmit-multiplicity correction.
